title: German Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew made with tender chunks of beef and a variety of vegetables, all slow-cooked in a rich broth. Perfect for a cold winter's night.

ingredients.name: Dried thyme
ingredients.notes: Fresh thyme can be used instead

instructions: Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion to the pot and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the carrots and potatoes to the pot and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, thyme, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1 1/2 hours.
Add the red wine to the pot and simmer for an additional 30 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme if desired.
